feedback:
Reviewed before racing, so no outcome is stated for this candidate. It changes one value from the best raced design (iteration 4, score 443.3): controller.kp 1.7 to 1.5, with kd 0.5, ki 0.02, base_speed 1.2, line_loss last_direction and all geometry and sensor_weights unchanged. All fields are within the contract ranges, and the single-variable change makes the result attributable.

The evidence supports this step. Iteration 2 (kp 2.5, score 141.8) showed that raising kp hurt slalom line loss (1.0 to 1.85) and oval progress (0.70 to 0.57). Lowering kp from 2.0 to 1.7 (iteration 4) then improved the score from 326.7 to 443.3, with oval finishes rising from 11 to 16 and s-bend finishes from 0 to 4, while slalom line loss stayed at 1.0. The kp trend therefore points downward on the oval and s-bend. The main risk is that kp 1.5 under-corrects tight oval bends (iteration 4 had 4 oval off-track ends), and slalom line loss may not respond to gain at all.

Read the next race as follows. If oval finishes stay at about 14 or more of 20 with progress at or above 0.9, and s-bend finishes or progress rise, keep kp 1.5 as the new best and test base_speed 1.4 as the next single change, since speed is the next limit once line loss is controlled. If slalom line_loss_events fall below 1.0 with kp 1.5, the gain was part of the slalom problem, so continue the kp trend only if the oval holds. If oval finishes or progress fall clearly, revert kp to 1.7, the best raced value. If slalom line_loss_events stay at 1.0 regardless of kp, gain is not the cause on slalom, so the next test should be kd 0.6 or line_loss search_left or search_right, not further kp reduction. If steering_oscillation on the s-bend rises above 0.4 (it was 0.40 at kp 1.7), use kd 0.6 with oscillation as the guard.
requested_changes: If the oval holds (about 14 or more finishes, progress at or above 0.9) and s-bend or slalom line loss falls, keep controller.kp at 1.5 and test controller.base_speed 1.4 as the next single change, because speed is the next limit once line loss is controlled.

If oval finishes or progress fall clearly from iteration 4 values (16 finishes, progress 0.96), revert controller.kp to 1.7 with kd 0.5, since iteration 4 showed the gain gain was the best trade-off so far and further reduction should not be taken on oval evidence alone.

If slalom line_loss_events stay at 1.0 with kp 1.5, do not lower kp further; test controller.kd 0.6 (or line_loss 'search_left' or 'search_right' as a comparison) with steering_oscillation as the guard, since iteration 4 kept s-bend oscillation at 0.40 at kd 0.5.
